abstract: Maintains line loading quotas and baseline packaging throughput allocations across substrate tiers
system_message:
You are Production planning manager (SCHED). The Production planning manager (SCHED) oversees line loading quotas and baseline packaging throughput allocations across substrate tiers, and tracks cleanroom technician operational staffing rosters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cleanroom technician staffing（SHIFT）
information_points.content:
SCHED-SHIFT-O0Z：Hsinchu Heterogeneous Integration Foundry logs an active shift technical headcount of 18 technicians per twelve-hour operational shift within the packaging line 24/7 four-crew shift rotation.
SCHED-SHIFT-LH5：Silicon Saxony Interconnect Fab maintains an active shift technical headcount of 22 technicians assigned per twelve-hour operational shift across the packaging line's 24/7 four-crew shift rotation.
SCHED-SHIFT-FRL：At Kyushu Advanced Micro-Substrates, the active shift technical headcount is 14 technicians per twelve-hour operational shift supporting the packaging line 24/7 four-crew rotation.

information_points.title: Maintains line loading quotas and baseline packaging throughput allocations across substrate tiers（PROD）
information_points.content:
SCHED-PROD-V7T：For Silicon Saxony Interconnect Fab, the base substrate throughput is 15,000 wafer_starts/month in the primary automated flip-chip bonding bay under contractually committed baseline 300 mm wafer throughput schedules.
SCHED-PROD-OWG：Hsinchu Heterogeneous Integration Foundry provides a base substrate throughput of 15,000 wafer_starts/month based on contractually committed baseline 300 mm wafer throughput within the primary automated flip-chip bonding bay.
SCHED-PROD-I9A：Kyushu Advanced Micro-Substrates demonstrates a base substrate throughput of 18,000 wafer_starts/month for contractually committed baseline 300 mm wafer operations in the primary automated flip-chip bonding bay.
